data.name: Azfar
data.gender_notes: Azfar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Azfar is a strong and meaningful Arabic name for boys, meaning 'victorious' or 'successful in battle'. It reflects courage, strength, and a winning spirit, often associated with leadership and honor. The name Azfar carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Azfar usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes triumph of good over difficulty, and the strength to overcome life’s trials with integrity.
data.etymology: Azfar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azfar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أزفر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الازفار، يعني كثير الغلبة والظفر
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الازفار الذي يعني كثير الغلبة والظفر، ويتميز صاحبه بالشجاعة والقدرة على التغلب على الصعاب. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان آية ٢٧: ﴿وَيُدخِلُهُمُ الجِنانَ الَّتي وَصَفَها لَهُم في القُرآنِ جَنّاتُ عَدنٍ تَجري مِن تَحتِها الأَنهارُ خالِدينَ فيها أَبَداً﴾ وقد ذكر اسم أزفر في بعض الأحاديث النبوية.

in_urdu.name: ازفر
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے غالب، فتحیاب، کامیاب
in_urdu.long_meaning: ازفر ایک مذکر نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے غالب، فتحیاب، کامیاب۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور قرآن کریم میں بھی اس کا ذکر آیا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس نام کا ذکر خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خصوصاً انبیاء اور صحابہ کے سلسلے میں۔

in_hindi.name: अज़फ़र

in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़फ़र एक पुरुष नाम है जिसका अर्थ है विजयी, सफल, और प्रभुत्वशाली। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का विशेष महत्व है, खासकर पैगंबर और सहाबा के वंश में।

in_pashto.name: ازفر
in_pashto.meaning: د ازفارو معنی دی غالب، بریالی، کامياب

in_english.name: Azfar
in_english.meaning: Victorious, triumphant, one who achieves success
in_english.long_meaning: Azfar is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning victorious, triumphant, or one who achieves success. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'az-far', it connotes the idea of overcoming challenges and emerging triumphant. The name has historical significance in Islamic tradition and is mentioned in various Quranic verses and Hadiths. It symbolizes courage, resilience, and determination, qualities highly valued in Islamic culture.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azfar carries a proud and storied legacy in Islamic history. It evokes images of valiant warriors defending their faith, their lands, and their people. In this way, the name represents not just a personal triumph, but a communal victory against adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Azfar holds profound implications. It encourages its bearer to strive for success not just in worldly matters, but in the pursuit of righteousness and goodness in the eyes of God. The name is a constant reminder to be a victor in the most meaningful of battles – the battle for one's own soul.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Azfar means "the one who carries the message." It symbolizes the role of a messenger or a bearer of good news and the importance of spreading knowledge and truth in the community.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Azfar ibn Marwan was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Azfar carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Azfar ibn Marwan was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad during his lifetime. He is mentioned in various hadiths and is considered to be one of the early supporters of Islam.
